entries.title: Raft

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full release and the best capture/input route. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S ports are valid current console routes with cross-play, but they do not add sourced exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Raft on Steam for Windows PC and play the current Final Chapter build. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only if a console/cross-play route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Final Chapter is the 1.0/full-release content update, not a separate game entry. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are later ports/access routes, not remasters.
